modules.module_title: Signal the vessel in and out of berth

pcs.pc_description: confirm berthing plan with the ship and yard planning supervisor and the vessel operator
communicate with vessel using VHF radio, flags and hand signals to guide the vessel for docking
communicate with the outgoing vessel regarding a go-ahead using flags once mooring lines are dis-engaged

modules.module_title: Signal crane operators for cargo movement

inform the crane / MHE operator on any issues based on observation of cargo and environment
identify impending dangers and communicate to the crane operator regarding the same
report to supervisor at the end of the task
escalate any accidents, damages or issues to the supervisor
